name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding Manager | Relationship-First Customer Onboarding & Cross-Functional Handoffs
summary: Onboarding professional with 15+ years owning the customer relationship from deal close through a documented handoff to Customer Success, in B2B SaaS and MarTech environments. Directly managed and trained a team of onboarding specialists at Wix while personally onboarding 25+ clients per month, and onboarded a network of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye with 94% retention, auditing account setup, flagging issues early, and keeping documentation current in real time. Builds technical, API-integrated CRM and automation systems for clients at Solenzo today.
